label: Collapse Nested State Reductions
rationale: Nested projections Pi_2 o Pi_1 collapse into single composite projection Pi.

label: Intersect Sequential Admissibility Sets
rationale: Sequential admissibility constraints collapse into set intersection A_1 intersect A_2.

label: Merge Negative Information Ledgers
rationale: Sequential negative information directives merge into single union ledger N_1 union N_2.

label: Alphabetize Commuting Orthogonal Primitives
rationale: Primitives with [p1, p2] = 0 are sorted into canonical alphabetical order to prevent syntactic duplication.
